# Patterns paper

> The journal version of this paper (revised and restructured) is Paper III in [`docs/papers/`](../papers/README.md).

_Deletion, Arrows, Windows and Composition: a Classification of Structural Patterns in Certified Polytope
Packings_ (7 November 2026).

* `patterns.tex`: the manuscript; `patterns.pdf`: compiled.
* `macros.tex`, `table_families.tex`: generated by `scripts/patterns/paper_macros.py` from
  `docs/patterns/stats.json`. Every catalogue number in the paper comes from these.
* `fig_*.pdf` / `fig_*.png`: generated by `scripts/patterns/figures.py`.

Rebuild:

```
python3 scripts/patterns/features.py          # docs/patterns/features3d.json   (about 4 min)
python3 scripts/patterns/inherit.py           # docs/patterns/inherit3d.json    (about 90 min)
python3 scripts/patterns/rotations.py         # docs/patterns/rotations3d.json
python3 scripts/patterns/stats.py             # docs/patterns/stats.json
python3 scripts/patterns/paper_macros.py      # macros.tex, table_families.tex
python3 scripts/patterns/figures.py           # figures
python3 scripts/patterns/figures.py arrow <arrow result json>
python3 scripts/patterns/contacts.py 30        # docs/patterns/contacts3d.json
python3 scripts/patterns/transfer.py           # docs/patterns/transfer.json (one-piece scales, numerical)
python3 scripts/patterns/relations.py          # docs/patterns/relations.json
python3 scripts/patterns/relations_macros.py   # relations_macros.tex
python3 scripts/patterns/fig_relations.py      # fig_relations.pdf
python3 scripts/patterns/features_nd.py        # docs/patterns/features_nd.json, inherit_nd.json (4D-6D, about 1.5 h)
python3 scripts/patterns/stats_nd.py           # docs/patterns/stats_nd.json
python3 scripts/patterns/nd_macros.py          # nd_macros.tex
cd docs/patterns-paper && latexmk -pdf patterns.tex
```

The Lean theorems cited are in `lean-optimality/PackingOptimality/` (`Patterns.lean`, `Windows.lean`,
`Triakis.lean`, `Relations.lean`, `PrismCube.lean`, `TriPrismCube.lean`, `PolyPrism.lean`, `LemmaF5.lean`,
`LemmaF5Sphere.lean`, `Penteracts.lean`, `Basic.lean`), built and axiom-audited by `.github/workflows/lean-optimality.yml`.
